__NOTOC__
{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Cuisine of the United States|American cuisine]] | [[Cookbook:Vegetarian cuisine|Vegetarian Cuisine]] | [[Cookbook:Beverages|Beverages]]

==Ingredients==
* 2 [[Cookbook:Pound|lb]] (about 1 [[Cookbook:Kilogram|kg]]) tender [[Cookbook:Rhubarb|rhubarb]], [[Cookbook:Chop|chopped]]
* 5 [[Cookbook:Cup|cups]] [[Cookbook:Water|water]]
* ¼ cup [[Cookbook:Lemon Juice|lemon juice]]

==Procedure==
# Combine the rhubarb and water in a non-aluminum pot. Cook until mushy.
# [[Cookbook:Straining|Strain]] the mixture well, reserving only the juice.
# Mix in lemon juice.

== Notes, tips, and variations ==
* It's important to use a non-aluminum pot, because when combined with an acidic food like rhubarb, aluminum can impart an unpleasant flavor.

==Use==

* For each cup of concentrate, add ⅓ cup [[Cookbook:Sugar|sugar]] and ½ cup [[Cookbook:Grapefruit|grapefruit juice]], and chill well.
* Just before serving, add 1 [[Cookbook:Quart|quart]] chilled [[Cookbook:Ginger Ale|ginger ale]] and stir well.
